nom: SUNGBOON EDITOR Deep Collagen Power Boosting Overnight Sheet Mask

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one who calls her skin 'dry, lifeless,' report the mask stays adhered comfortably and leaves skin shiny, soft, and well moisturized.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive are split: several say the mask did not irritate or break them out and found it soothing, especially when chilled before application, while others — including one who flags PEG-100 near the top of the ingredient list — report reactions ranging from redness and itchy bumps to a reaction described as a chemical burn with swelling.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s and 50s report smoother, plumper-looking skin and a visible softening of fine lines, under-eye wrinkles, and the 'elevens' between the brows, with several noting compliments from family members after use.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination, sensitive skin who says she breaks out easily reports the mask did not aggravate her skin during eight hours of overnight wear.

concerns.aging: Reviewers across a range of ages, including several in their 40s and 50s, report smoother, plumper, firmer-looking skin and a visible reduction in fine lines and wrinkles — including under-eye lines and the 'elevens' between the brows — after use, with one reviewer describing a year of consistent weekly use leading to a marked improvement in texture and brightness; a couple of reviewers note the smoothing effect is short-lived and fades within hours to days.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin consistently report a strong hydration boost, describing skin as glowing, plump, soft, and glass-like after use, with the effect lasting from several hours up to a few days for some; one reviewer notes the mask delivers its main benefit well before the advertised overnight wear time is up.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no redness or irritation, with several explicitly noting no allergic reaction after use; however, a handful describe the opposite — visible redness and itchy bumps across the forehead and chin, or, in one case, a reaction described as a chemical burn with swelling that persisted for several days.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports her acne scars appeared less noticeable with regular use.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who describe themselves as acne- or breakout-prone report the mask did not trigger new breakouts and, in one case, helped calm existing blemishes during hormonal flare-ups; one reviewer, however, reports the worst breakout of her life across her forehead and chin after a single overnight use, alongside redness and itching consistent with a reaction.

aspects.libelle: Thick jelly texture that turns clear
Prone to slipping before it sets
Fit doesn't suit all face shapes

extraits.texte: Sensitive skin warning!!! I used these a couple times with little reaction starting in may but in December I had a crazy reaction. Because I didn't think it came from these as id been using them, I went to the doctors multiple times and nobody could figure it out. Well I used this Friday night, Saturday I woke up and felt like my skin was on fire and it was insanely red, and today (Sunday) it's even worse and swollen. Am now being told it's a chemical burn reaction 😩

I was super excited to try these. My excitement was short lived. I cleaned my face before bed, put the mask on and wore it all night. I woke up and my face felt sticky, not glowy. My skin is by no means perfect, I wouldn’t say I’m acne prone. My entire forehead and chin broke out the worst I have ever had in my life. It’s almost more like an allergic reaction. It’s red, tons of bumps/pimples and it itches. It’s been like this for two days and doesn’t seem to be getting much better.

The packaging says 30-40 minutes so I tried the first mask and basically wasted it. I learned it tears easily so handle gently. The small holes cut out were useful to cover my wrinkling eyelids. The result wasn't bad but I thought it was the wrong type of mask. After more reading, I tried again for 8 hours during sleep. Thankfully there were 4 in each package. No odor and a white jelly-soft texture when applied. It turned clear but still flexible to peel off with a little sticky residue leftover. Too bad I didn't do a before photo but I used one from a few days ago to show the difference. BTW I'm 40 and break out easily and have combination, sensitive skin. This didn't aggravate anything. Very happy and will be buying more for weekly use.

I was skeptical but everyone told me to try it! I have such dry skin and didn’t have high hopes for the comfort of this type of mask. But it stayed on so well, after around an hour it was stuck to my skin and didn’t move while I slept(and I slept, it was comfortable)! It has a great cooling effect, a neutral smell, and it was very durable as I moved it around several times or rubbed it more into my skin. Considering I’ll add this to my weekly routine it’s a great price!

Guess my age….I’m 53. I love this mask. It does on white then blends into your skin. I’ve slept it but find it’s best to walk the house with it on for about 2-3 hours because the product gets rubbed off while you sleep. It plumps my skin and gives it a beautiful glow.

extraits.titre: By far my favorite face mask
extraits.texte: I love these face masks! When they go on, they’re very white and thick and as it sits on your skin, it becomes clear. I noticed my fine lines and wrinkles are smooth. My skin is hydrated. I also feel like my acne scars are not as noticeable. I’m trying to do this mask at least three times a week.
